themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Far-right and populist right parties across Scandinavia and Western Europe are demonstrating strong polling momentum and positioning for direct executive power. From Norway's Fremskrittspartiet surging to historic poll numbers to Sweden Democrats competing in traditional industrial heartlands and France's Rassemblement National laying out governance plans, right-wing movements are framing themselves as ready to govern.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Surges in polls to become Norway's largest party at 31.4%, with leader Sylvi Listhaug challenging Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Campaigns in traditional Social Democratic northern industrial strongholds while leadership positions the party for future ministerial roles.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Lays groundwork for 2027 presidential governance, preparing constitutional referendum plans despite internal Le Pen-Bardella leadership friction.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are using executive action, official civic channels, and popular media to assert nationalist identity and traditionalist cultural narratives. In Argentina, President Javier Milei officially restored historical holiday nomenclature, while the US White House deployed pro-policy retro arcade games and pursued controversial monumental civic architecture.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei signed a decree reverting the October 12 holiday back to the traditional nationalist name 'Day of the Race'.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The White House launched retro arcade games promoting border wall construction while facing court oversight on proposed monumental arches and construction.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Strict border enforcement and national priority policies remain key political focal points for right-wing leaders internationally. The Trump administration is accelerating mass deportation logistics and ICE operations in the US, while France's Rassemblement National champions constitutional reform to enact explicit national priority rules over non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Expands mass deportation infrastructure, state-level ICE operations, and border enforcement publicity campaigns.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes a proposed constitutional referendum to restrict immigration and give French citizens national priority for state benefits.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are engaged in significant legal and constitutional battles over voting procedures, campaign finance, and institutional rules. In the US, the administration faces repeated judicial blocks over mail voting rules and voter database purges, while France's Rassemblement National proposes direct voter referendums to circumvent constitutional and EU law constraints.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Faces federal appeals court blocks over mail ballot restrictions and voter purge databases while steering mega PAC funding into key midterm races.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Plans to bypass existing constitutional and EU legal primacy rules via a direct presidential referendum.

themes.title: Far-Right Stances on Foreign Conflicts and Security
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are navigating intense debate and scrutiny regarding their foreign policy stances and foreign influence risks. While the US administration manages high-stakes posture toward Iran and Russia-Ukraine peace envoys, European right-wing parties face political attacks and internal security scrutiny regarding pro-Russian rhetoric and positioning.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Executes aggressive military signaling against Iran while sending peace envoys to Moscow and Kyiv.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces sharp criticism from centrist rivals over its stance regarding Ukraine and foreign policy alignment.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Confronts national security infiltration concerns after revelations that a top official's partner spread pro-Russian propaganda.
